mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals active monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases real interest rates and suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for residential construction, which precedes broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST increases by at least 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) over the prior two months indicates expanding manufacturing output and strong supply-side economic activity, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% over the prior two months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals weakening residential demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains stable or rises, it indicates a tightening monetary cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS stable/rising fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-recession recovery periods when UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points month-over-month.
